description: Arrêts lignes régulières réseau de transport urbain à Autun is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grand Autunois Morvan. Urban transport in the municipality of Autun is organized around urban lines (with or without reservation). Circulation all year round from Monday to Saturday, except holidays. Some stops are not served systematically. Coverage: Grand Autunois Morvan. The portal shows the English title as "Regular line stops urban transport network in Autun" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grand Autunois Morvan. Its keywords include autun, transport, bus, transport-en-commun. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2025-11-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
